955-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
955-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2317-5231-6763-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

728-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-4302-5929.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2557-3129-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-3129-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2034-4013-7205.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two colors among permanents you control.
2034-4013-7205.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kithkeeper.
When Kithkeeper enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1368-2033-6321-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-6321-6633.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

893-1558-4840-6005.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Myr.
893-1558-4840-6005.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it and five Myr, searching your library for Myr Battlesphere and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat each turn.

1558-3257-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3257-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2557-5448-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-5448-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2438-5220-5708-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

3525-3664-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Pemmin's Aura attached using Lotus Field's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

471-4826-6712.notablePrerequisites:
Pestilence Demon has indestructible.
Sonic has indestructible.
471-4826-6712.description:
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sonic triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that is dealt damage, creating that many untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
471-4826-6712.notes: It is strongly recommended to perform this combo once you have the highest life total to end the game. It is, however, not a requirement.

3525-6218-6723.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1456-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat

222-527-1753-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1753-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1274-4476-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4476-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3000-3845-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-3845-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2366-5003-6528.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1029-5028-5821.description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Fyndhorn Elder.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5821.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1350-3443--85.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight creature cards in your graveyard.
You have two mana of {W}, {B} or {G} available, and then an additional mana of those colors except the color of the two mana.
1350-3443--85.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least eight {W}, {B} or {G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

342-2590-4231-5670.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control another creature.
342-2590-4231-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate the Food by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Experimental Confectioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Food ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-3769-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
997-3769-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2653-2783.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

957-1809-1987-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1809-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

2059-2136.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
2059-2136.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2781-3129-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2781-3129-5917.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

3484-4518-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Kor Skyfisher
3484-4518-5674.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1247-4893.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
457-1247-4893.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {U}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

527-1849-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-1849-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

868-1031-1170-5293.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library and/or graveyard for Rite of Flame and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Rite of Flame by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Desperate Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

4559-4659-4814-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You conrol noncreature artifacts with a total mana value of 10 or greater.
"Mirran" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
4559-4659-4814-4871.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure and Myr, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-876-1914.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Cowardice triggers, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1256-2713-4289-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1256-2713-4289-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1177-2286.description:
During your opponent's draw step, they draw a card, and Teferi's Puzzle Box triggers.
Resolve the Teferi's Puzzle Box trigger, causing the opponent to put the cards in their hand onto the bottom of their library and draw no cards due to Narset.

1636-2545-3524-4096-4659.description:
Sacrifice Gleaming Barrier to Krark-Clan Ironworks, generating {C}{C} and {W} from the treasure.
Activate Golbin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Idol of Endurance and returning Gleaming Barrier from the graveyard to the battlefield and triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping Goblin Welder and leaving {2}{W} floating.
Activate Golbin Welder, sacrificing Gleaming Barrier and returning Idol of Endurance to play, exiling Gleaming Barrier to Idol of Endurance's trigger and adding {W} through the treasure, leaving {2}{W}{W} floating.
Activate Idol of Endurance for {1}{W} and cast Gleaming Barrier without paying its mana cost, triggering Intruder Alarm and untapping Goblin Welder, leaving {1}{W} floating.
Repeat for infinite colored and colorless mana.
